## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and its scope.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Native bundle check, if the Tauri shell, installer, or daemon bundle changed

## Privacy and release checks

- [ ] No private task data, tokens, local databases, or generated bundle output is included.
- [ ] Documentation and changelog are updated when users need different guidance.
